The main takeaway from our work is that
, despite the overall structural similarity of Deg5 and Deg6 to the bacterial DegP and DegQ, respectively, they differ in the way they interact with their substrates.
Arabidopsis Degs have unique structural features that distinguish them from the DegP and DegQ HtrAs, and that these features are likely to contribute to their substrate specificity.
